# DegenView

> DegenView is a free, open source TradingView alternative for the desktop (macOS, Windows, Linux). It has multi-chart layouts for crypto, stocks and prediction markets, a local Pine Script v6 engine, alerts with webhooks, bar replay, paper trading, portfolio tracking and an optional MCP server for AI assistants. No account is needed. Licensed GPL-3.0-only.

DegenView is an independent project and is not affiliated with TradingView.
